_comment: Hunter Kael — side & repeatable quests. Order: reports first, then reminders, then offers (run offer is the catch-all).

1.speaker: Hunter Kael
1.text: Ashport is the last town before the salt flats, and the first one the ash reached. Kael is waiting at the gate.

2.speaker: Hunter Kael
2.text: Reach Visited Ashport. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: Hunter Kael
1.text: The scouts are ranging further west than raiders ever did, and they are not carrying loot -- they are carrying orders.

2.speaker: Hunter Kael
2.text: Slay 6 Barrens Scout. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: Hunter Kael
1.text: Kael wants four insignia off four different brutes. He says two matching ones will tell him which captain is moving.

2.speaker: Hunter Kael
2.text: Gather 4 Raider Insignia. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: Hunter Kael
1.text: The old smelting works has been lit for three weeks. It has no coal.

2.speaker: Hunter Kael
2.text: Reach Entered Slagworks. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: Hunter Kael
1.text: Whatever has been feeding the furnace has a shape, and the shape has a grudge.

2.speaker: Hunter Kael
2.text: Slay 1 The Slag Wraith. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: Hunter Kael
1.text: Brother Ashe's order held the Scorched Monastery for eighty years. The gate is open, which is the first thing wrong with it.

2.speaker: Hunter Kael
2.text: Reach Entered Scorched Monastery. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: Hunter Kael
1.text: The brutes have billeted themselves in the nave. Kael finds that obscene on grounds he refuses to explain.

2.speaker: Hunter Kael
2.text: Slay 9 Raider Brute. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: Hunter Kael
1.text: Something in the salt beds is drilling. Kael wants the drilling stopped before it reaches the water.

2.speaker: Hunter Kael
2.text: Slay 12 Slag Lizard. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: Hunter Kael
1.text: Kael has a buyer for emberglass and, more tellingly, a buyer who is in a hurry.

2.speaker: Hunter Kael
2.text: Gather 5 Emberglass Shard. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: Hunter Kael
1.text: The Choir has formed a legion out of people who used to be Cinderhold's. Kael asks you not to think about their faces.

2.speaker: Hunter Kael
2.text: Slay 8 Choir Legionnaire. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: Hunter Kael
1.text: The legion has started wearing Ashvow's colours under the Choir's grey. Kael wants the grey ones put down where the city can see it.

2.speaker: Hunter Kael
2.text: Slay 6 Choir Legionnaire. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: Hunter Kael
1.text: The insignia match. Two captains, one order, and the order came from Ashvow.

2.speaker: Hunter Kael
2.text: Speak with Hunter Kael. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: Hunter Kael
1.text: Eight loads of scrap for the last forge still working west of Ashvow.

2.speaker: Hunter Kael
2.text: Gather 8 Scrap Iron. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: Hunter Kael
1.text: Kael finally says the thing he has been walking around: the Choir takes people to make vessels, and the vessels are why the ash moves.

2.speaker: Hunter Kael
2.text: Speak with Hunter Kael. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: Hunter Kael
1.text: Three scouts down. Clean work — the barrens will feel that for a season.

2.speaker: Hunter Kael
2.text: Your coin, and a potion besides. Stay sharp out there.

1.speaker: Hunter Kael
1.text: Four emberlings, ash to ash. Here's your pay — and if more crawl out of the cinders, you know where to find me.

1.speaker: Hunter Kael
1.text: The scouts run in the tan barrens, west and north. Fast little devils — wait for their lunge, then roll behind and cut.

1.speaker: Hunter Kael
1.text: Emberlings hatch near the grasslands' edge. Four of them and you've earned your coin.

1.speaker: Hunter Kael
1.text: You've got the look of someone who's used a blade. Good. I could use one more pair of hands.

2.speaker: Hunter Kael
2.text: Barrens scouts have been shadowing our foragers. Three of them, dead, and I'll make it worth your while.

4.speaker: Hunter Kael
4.text: Good. Tan barrens, west and north. Bring back the tale if not the tails.

1.speaker: Hunter Kael
1.text: Emberlings keep crawling out of the ash near the grasslands. Vermin, but they bite.

2.speaker: Hunter Kael
2.text: Cull four of them and I'll pay you. And again, if they keep coming. Always do.

1.speaker: Kael
1.text: Kael is, as always, half-way through a meal and entirely covered in ash.

3.speaker: Kael
3.text: Ash lies the same as snow, if you stop assuming it will not. Watch where the wind has not touched and you will find where something sleeps.

4.speaker: Kael
4.text: Because there is a door down there and it is not locked — it is only heavy. We have been getting heavier and it has been getting patient.

5.speaker: Kael
5.text: Not with me. Try the villagers; they have problems shaped like people, and those are cheaper to solve than the ones shaped like holes in the ground.

2.speaker: Kael
2.text: Go on. I have the time, which is the only thing anyone in this valley still has in quantity.

choices.text: How do you read a trail out here?
Why do the emberlings keep coming?
Any work that will not get me killed?

barks.text: Track the wind, not the prints. Prints lie.
Three scouts in one pass is a scouting party, not a patrol. Something's coming.
The barrens are quiet today. I don't trust quiet.
Stay off the ridge after dark. Things walk there that don't leave tracks.
